owner_and_capability: Settings Platform (settings and start page routes), Communication (user-facing platform announcement routes), Delivery Platform (PWA usage route over its usage service) and the Reminder Delivery workflow (staff reminder query route) each take their inbound HTTP adapter into their own http role; the root composition mounts them through ADR 0053 point 2. Four of the five packages of #4064; api/operator waits for #4063.
affected_tables: None: code-only package move, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One PR, policy epoch 44 -> 45. git mv api/config -> modules/settings/http (package settingshttp, settings-platform/http), api/platform -> modules/communication/http/platformannouncements (communication/http), api/pwa -> modules/delivery/http/pwa (delivery-platform/http) and api/reminders -> workflows/reminderdelivery/http (package reminderdeliveryhttp, reminder-delivery/http); only package clauses, import paths and aliases change. The owners inbound-config, inbound-platform, inbound-pwa and inbound-reminders are deleted. inbound-reminders.to.reminder-delivery becomes reminder-delivery.http.public; reminder-delivery.compose.http targets the workflow's own http role; reminder-delivery.adapter-test.http and inbound-platform.to.communication are deleted because adapter-test.http-subject and communication.http.public already allow those imports. root-composition.reach.platform.http adds the platform http reach that ADR 0053 point 2 lists, in production, internal_test and external_test, without an issue field. Four #2750 keys fall (25 -> 21); routes, status codes, error bodies, middleware chains and authorization are unchanged; composition surface stays at 139.
